title: Smiling Man Petting Jumping Collie Dog, 1950s Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-1950s black-and-white snapshot showing a smiling man bending forward to affectionately pet an excited Rough Collie standing on its hind legs. A small black puppy or terrier sits attentively between the man and the large dog. The scene is set outdoors along a quiet rural or suburban lane lined with bare seasonal trees, wooden fence posts, and a traditional house in the background.
